issues.description: The problem statement requires that set_pixel must not change any registers except EAX ("Außer dem Register eax dürfen keine anderen Registerinhalte verändert werden"). However, the template contains a conflicting comment near the address-calculation TODO that says to save registers you modify except EAX, EBX and ESI ("Attention: save all registers you modify except eax,ebx and esi"), implying EBX and ESI may be modified without saving. This contradiction between the specification and the template comments can confuse students about which registers they are allowed to modify in set_pixel.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the register-preservation rule consistent across artifacts. Either (A) update the template comment to match the problem statement (e.g. "Only EAX may be changed by set_pixel; save any other registers you modify"), or (B) if the intent was to allow modifying EBX/ESI, update the problem statement to explicitly permit modifying those registers and document which registers must be preserved. Also ensure the solution and any example code follow the same rule.
